items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Wiley Harris who was one of the promoters of the show

ctx.x: Earl was playing the Vulgar Boatman over there and here comes Hilton Lamar with the guitar, he's not playing in the orchestra and he's carrying a little handmade paper boat in front of that band and he's lugging along and the Vulgar Boatman is coming on in front of there. How the hell can you play? I'll tell you Pinky though, Pinky was fabulous at putting on those police shows, you get on and put that continuity out there, you couldn't play. You just had a laugh at him. There was no question about that.

Well the funny thing about the police shows was that these guys, and this is the most ridiculous thing of all, Wiley Harris who was one of the promoters of the show, every year they had to take a trip to the Edgewater Beach Hotel to hear the band to see if it would be acceptable to play for the police PMBA, Police Mutual Benefit Association. And he and a couple of other guys would have to go up to Chicago to hear the band to see if it was alright for them. Regardless of who it was, this band was coming to the…
I got a note here that says something about double headliner bill. Oh yeah, I found that on the newspaper. What was the double headliner bill, do you know, in a theater, like in Vaudeville?
